title: Complete spectator rows remove the active-axis stock restriction
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

A globally complete Hadamard call can take its row prefix and compact controls from spectator coordinates, complete all selected axes in one top-level active-core invocation, and restore the original coarse layout before the next diagonal. The prefix may be much larger than the active width. This is a constructive conditional interface proof with an executable sparse planner and an exact indexed reference; no new finite supplier or κ is claimed.

The retained SUPPORT-ROUTER extension moves at most 2hK coordinate positions. Placing its destination after an R-bit row prefix does not introduce an R-width transpose. Existing coordinates supply the rows; one padding increases volume by less than two. The completed operator is exactly `P⁻¹(I_ROW ⊗ C_T)P=C_S` for arbitrary correlated inputs. Replicated scalar blocks and address permutations retain their coefficient-norm and denominator bounds, so no coefficient guard proportional to R is added.

For total stock `log₂ Q=O(h^ν p^ζ polylog(p))`, the new condition at h=Θ(p^x) is **νx+ζ<1**, using ambient address space. It removes the active-width stock cutoff and row-driven polynomial fallback. The active core still performs its usual internal recursion. Q must be the complete product of nested requirements, generated within charged polynomial setup; the next coarse-dependent diagonal must wait for padding deletion and inverse exposure.

## Significance for researchers

This opens a supplier/representation contract excluded by active-axis reservation. Hypothetical completed U=B=.02 suppliers with precision exponent ρ=3/2 and stock h^(1/2)p^(3/5) polylog(p) now have a passing κ=.011 interface. Its global stock power is 217/240 and grouped power is 157/240, both below one; allocating that stock inside active axes would require β>6/5. The stronger suppliers and paid router remain missing, so this is an implementation target rather than a .011 multiplier.

The changed wrapper's exact 60-predicate arithmetic region is `E>1/2` and `OLD<κ<min(U,B,1/32)E`, where `E=min(1,1/ρ,(1−ζ)/ν)` for ν>0; omit the last term for ν=0 and require ζ<1. All nine outer savings stay unchanged. The source's current ζ=0 construction gains a no-deferral wrapper while its selected exponent stays the same.

## Task and overlap

Scientific base: canonical main 721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419, priority revision 8, selected [PR6030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6030). Card uniform-transfer-audit, changed scope to constructive ambient row allocation at the actual global-H boundary. [Discussion6056](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/6056) is the canonical investigation. Final overlap through 2026-10-28 04:36 UTC covers 337 open PR bodies and 5720 Discussion records with complete remote pagination; sparse local notes, historical diffs and unpublished work remain limits.

The retained tensor compiler explicitly uses the same H schedule for every coarse label, with label dependence confined to diagonals between completed calls. The new application uses that actual contract. It does not approve a fixed-label microbox, a row-dependent completed kernel or unpriced routing. Native, compiler, restoration, physical tape, numerical and analytic hypotheses remain. Rounded replacements need their complete error and padding-disposal guarantee; ideal zero rows alone do not authorize erasing residual errors.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.8 registered normal and optimized replays pass 600 sparse plans, all 384 Gaussian operator basis columns at six address bits against an independent column formula, 60 arbitrary payload/diagonal fixtures, seven rejection controls, 1920 rational witnesses across all 60 predicates, and six encoded production-layout checks. Controls cover missing inverse, row-dependent endpoint, early coarse diagonal, incomplete microbox, nonzero padded return, insufficient space and maximum-only stock. Exact committed bytes pass; all six existing navigation tests pass.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/spectator-row-reservoir`. The small fixtures use K=G=1 for execution; production descriptors separately check the actual K guard, per-axis neighborhoods, router reservoirs and protected suffix. Written proofs supply the all-size quantifiers. No selected cold replay, materialized production tensor, fixed-tape implementation, rounded Gaussian multiplier, Lean, Docker or independent human review ran. Optional full-history checking is unavailable in this shallow checkout.

The unchanged navigation repair from [PR6050](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6050) is included so shared planning can reach the new scientific replay. Frozen consumers with stale navigation pins remain unchanged.

## Credit

Prepared by [zxv](https://github.com/zxv), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, source review, implementation, verification and writing. The sparse S∪T extension itself is retained SUPPORT-ROUTER work; the new result is its spectator-prefix placement and complete-callee/stock application. Credit [Nick Petalas](https://github.com/petalas)'s [PR5984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5984) unchanged-ledger theorem, the prior policy in [PR6062](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6062), [Vlado Vojdanovski](https://github.com/Vlado-V)'s [PR1673](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1673), [Jeremy Kothe](https://github.com/jeremykothe2)'s [PR1758](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1758), [Chafik Boukhalfa](https://github.com/chafreaky)'s [PR1786](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1786), the [PR4359](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4359) stock/semantic-precision framework, [DreamingOfClouds](https://github.com/DreamingOfClouds)'s [PR6030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6030), and the retained compact-layout, global-H, adversarial support audit, Harvey–van der Hoeven and OpenAI manuscript lineage. Apache-2.0 and source-specific notices remain.

## Open next questions

Install the planner at one literal global-H invocation with exported neighborhoods, complete Q, physical header/suffix geometry and returned endpoint. Then identify a fully charged supplier that benefits from the ambient stock allowance, or bind a rounded callee to this padding/restoration boundary. The package records concrete first steps and blockers; those implementations are not assumed complete here.
